text:
elaine: Quick design review — I'm worried the roles table looks cramped at smaller widths. Also SSO toggle label 'Enforce SSO' is ambiguous; customers asked if it's per-user or org-wide. Also audit log nav: clicking Audit drops to the bottom with no breadcrumb. kai: Agree on density. Can we reduce row padding or show secondary info collapsed? A compact density toggle in user settings could work. :thinking: priya: For SSO label, 'Require SSO for all users' reads clearer. Could add a microcopy link to docs and a small tooltip with what 'Require' means. dan_m: Accessibility nit: the toggle needs aria-describedby pointing to help text; focus ring missing in high-contrast. I'll paste a quick snippet: ``` This requires users to sign in via your configured SSO provider (SAML/OIDC). ``` priya: Love that. Also propose copy alternatives: 'Enforce SSO for organization' vs 'Require SSO for all users' — lean towards latter (shorter). kai: On roles table: can we add a 'compact' icon in the header that toggles row density? Also sticky column for role names when horizontally scrolling. design-bot: Uploaded mock: https://assets.redwood.ai/ux/mocks/roles-compact-v2.png (preview) elaine: Audit log nav: users expect to filter by actor + resource. Current filter panel is collapsed behind 'Advanced' — let's surface top-level filters and keep pagination numbered, not infinite scroll. Also add 'jump to time' search. dan_m: For audit accessibility: ensure table rows are keyboard focusable and announce when filters are applied (use live region). Example aria: ```
Filter: Last 7 days, Actor: 'deploy-bot'
``` priya: Microcopy tweak for roles hover: instead of 'Inherited perms' let's show 'Inherited from parent org/team' — clearer for non-technical admins. kai: Sizing suggestion: keep 8px vertical padding in compact, 12px default. That keeps density without losing tappable targets on mobile. elaine: Next steps: @kai to prototype compact + sticky role col, @priya to update all microcopy, @dan_m to file a11y tickets and add aria snippets to component lib. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to review mocks. Thanks! :sparkles: priya: sgtm :+1: dan_m: filing tickets now — will link in thread. kai: I'll push a quick Figma prototype by EOD. design-bot: Note: added redlines to Figma. Check comments.
